listData.notes: Forbes' own list JSON (the endpoint its list page calls). The response's count field is 3028 and all 3,028 entries carry year 2025. Net worths are finalWorthBillions (USD billions); rank is the list rank, shared on ties. Entries carry a date field of 1743483660000 (2025-04-01, the list's publication date), except one entry (Amos Hostetter, Jr., not one of the 100). The live forbes.com/billionaires/ page now serves the 2026 list, so the 2025 methodology was read from the billionaires-2025-directory payload, whose metadata title confirms it is the 2025 list.
